methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The article gives a methodology to assess the effectiveness of the QMS, which can be used in practice by enterprises that implement the ISO 50001 standard.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a general quality-management-system (QMS) effectiveness-assessment methodology (a weighted-average composite index Q = sum(m_i * P_i) plus Harrington's desirability scale) for ISO 50001 implementation, but identifies and characterises no energy performance indicator (EnPI) or energy baseline (EnB) model. The indicators aggregated are generic product-quality/effectiveness measures, not an energy quantity; energy performance measurement is discussed only in general terms.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The methodology to assess the effectiveness of the QMS consists of stages, which are presented in Figure 2.

stage1.notes: Ineligible: the proposed method measures QMS/management-system effectiveness (weighted-average index + Harrington scale), not an EnPI/EnB energy-performance model, despite the ISO 50001 framing.
